# V8.5.0 release-blocker repair

- Replaces two literal Unicode-arrow strings in `scripts/validate.ps1` with `[char]0x2192` expressions so Windows PowerShell 5.1 cannot misdecode the arrow byte sequence as a quote character.
- Does not change the validated phrase or any skill behavior.
- The temporary repair workflow was removed before review.
- The branch must pass PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1 before merge.
